title: Patch change
description: The latest Star Citizen patch change an admin recorded for everyone, with its options, and the member's state in the latest home-location phase. Only what was created or started before a patch change's live time was touched.

patchChange.description: The latest patch change; absent before the first.

id.description: The patch change's id, the same in every feed entry the patch change caused.

label.description: The patch label, e.g. 4.4; an admin may correct it later.

kind.description: A long-term persistence rebuild or a full wipe; the kind only preset the options.

liveAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC: when the patch went live in the game. Every effect touched only what was created or started before it.

options.title: Patch change options
options.description: The options as the admin triggered the patch change.

wipeGroups.description: Every wipe group in a fixed order, wiped or not, with the catalogue types it claims.

wipeExceptions.description: Single items and materials kept although their group was wiped, or wiped although it was not; an exception's entry follows it, never its group.

cancelRefineryOrders.description: Whether running refinery orders started before the live time were cancelled.

currencyWipe.description: Whether the Kartellbank was reset as of the live time.

homeLocationPrompt.description: Whether the members were asked for a new home location.

selected.description: Whether the patch change wiped this group's stock or ships from before the live time.

types.description: The catalogue types the group claims. OTHER_ITEMS lists none: it takes every item no other group claims.

source.description: The catalogue fact the value is compared with, in the order an entry is matched.

value.description: The type key, e.g. Food, WeaponAttachment:Magazine, Char_Armor_ or RAW.

entry.description: The item or material, named by its bt and display name as the stock feed names it.

target.description: Whether the entry is an item, or a material in every quality.

homeLocationPrompt.title: Home-location prompt
homeLocationPrompt.description: The member's state in the latest patch change that asked for a new home location, which need not be the latest patch change.

state.description: NOT_ASKED: no phase asks the member, none ever ran or the account is younger than the live time. PENDING: the phase is open and the member has not chosen. RELOCATED: the member chose and was relocated. PHASE_ENDED: the phase ended before the member chose.

patchChange.description: The patch change that asked; absent when none ever asked.

liveAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC: the asking patch change's live time; only lots and ships created before it move. Absent when none ever asked.

chosen.description: The chosen home location; absent before the choice, or once the location was deleted.

chosenAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC: when the member chose and was relocated; absent before the choice.

locations.description: The curated home locations on offer, by name. Empty when an admin curated none.

preview.description: While the member is PENDING, what the relocation would move from each current location: only stock rows and ships created before the live time. Empty otherwise.

homeLocation.title: Home location
homeLocation.description: A curated home location, with the id a choice names.

id.description: The location's id; send it as a choice's location.

system.description: The star system of the location's city or station; absent when unknown.

guid.description: The DataForge GUID of the starmap object the location stands for, as location.schema.json describes it; absent when none is linked.

location.description: The current location; absent for ships without a location.

rows.description: The member's stock rows there, own and pool rows together.

pools.description: The share of those rows the member holds for each org unit's pool.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

homeLocationChoice.title: Home-location choice
homeLocationChoice.description: The member's choice in the open phase: final, once per member and phase. It relocates the member in the same request.

location.description: The id of one of the home locations the read offers.

homeLocationChosen.title: Chosen home location
homeLocationChosen.description: The chosen home location and what the relocation moved there; read the patch change again for the member's new state.

rows.description: How many of the member's stock rows moved.

ships.description: How many of the member's ships moved.
